description.value: Café Today is a neighbourhood coffee shop and all-day breakfast café in Nanaimo that has been serving fresh food and drinks since 2015. The café sources organic coffee beans from a local roaster and prepares all food on the day it is sold, offering an extensive menu of omelettes, sandwiches, wraps, bagels, and specialty coffee drinks. It has earned multiple third-party awards from platforms including Restaurant Guru and DoorDash, reflecting a strong local following.

address.value: Unit 4, 5771 Turner Rd, Nanaimo, BC V9T 6L8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the OSM phone number and unit address. The menu page documents DoorDash online ordering (confirming takeout) and lists numerous vegetarian items (Veggie Ranch Wrap, Avocado Toast, Spinach Feta Omelette, Green Salad, etc.), though no bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM address field is empty but the website supplies the full address, which is consistent with the OSM addr:unit=4 tag.
concerns: OSM address field is empty; full address (Unit 4, 5771 Turner Rd, Nanaimo BC V9T 6L8) sourced entirely from website — contact_confirmed.address set to null as there was no OSM value to corroborate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-reviewed café with a confirmed address, working website, and a substantial food and coffee menu that makes it a useful meal stop for touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo.
